Standard: The air vehicle's turn coordination in forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) does not result in handling qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess turn coordination performance as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Roll-Sideslip Coupling and Turn Coordination paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. An established threshold defining the lower limit of Level 2 flying qualities is not provided in MIL-DTL 32742, therefore compliance with the standard is expected to be qualitative only. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess turn coordination performance as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Roll-Sideslip Coupling and Turn Coordination paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. An established threshold defining the lower limit of Level 2 flying qualities is not provided in MIL-DTL 32742, therefore compliance with the standard is expected to be qualitative only. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess turn coordination performance as specified in MIL- DTL-32742, Roll-Sideslip Coupling and Turn Coordination paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. An established threshold defining the lower limit of Level 2 flying qualities is not provided in MIL-DTL 32742, therefore compliance with the standard is expected to be qualitative only.
